en: I am currently a postdoctoral research fellow at ${href(institute.shcmusic)}, and also an external faculty member at the ${href(institute.music_engineering)}, under the supervision of Prof. ${href(person.jian_yang)}.
I received my Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) degree from ${href(institute.seu)} in 2019.
I received my Doctor of Engineering (Ph.D.) degree from ${href(institute.tsinghua)} in 2024, under the supervision of Prof. ${href(person.jie_zhou)} and Prof. ${href(person.jiwen_lu)}.
During my Ph.D. studies, I mainly focused on computer vision within the field of artificial intelligence.

After joining the Shanghai Conservatory of Music, my research shifted toward music artificial intelligence, with a particular focus on the professional analysis and understanding of classical music, as well as Chinese folk music.
My current teaching covers artificial intelligence topics such as machine learning.

I am also a practitioner of the guqin, first introduced to it through a guqin elective course at Tsinghua University, and now studying under the guidance of Prof. ${href(person.xiaolian_dai)} at ${href(institute.shcmusic)}.
In addition, I studied piano as an amateur for about ten years, starting from the age of five.
zh: 我目前在${href_zh(institute.shcmusic)}从事博士后研究，并任${href_zh(institute.music_engineering)}外聘教师，合作导师为${href_zh(person.jian_yang)}教授。
2019年本科毕业于${href_zh(institute.seu)}${href_zh(institute.radio)}，获工学学士学位。
2024年博士毕业于${href_zh(institute.tsinghua)}${href_zh(institute.auto)}，获工学博士学位，
博士期间主要研究人工智能领域的计算机视觉。
加入上海音乐学院后，研究重心转向音乐人工智能，重点关注古典音乐的专业分析与理解，以及中国民族音乐。
目前教学涉及机器学习等人工智能内容。
我同时也是一名古琴研习者，启蒙于清华大学古琴选修课，现师从${href_zh(institute.shcmusic)}${href_zh(person.xiaolian_dai)}教授。
此外，我自五岁起业余学习钢琴，持续约十年。
